text:
Station personnel made reasonable efforts to upload the attached 
political file materials 
. See 47 U.S.C. § 315(e)(3), 47 C.F.R. 
§ 73.1943(d). However, the OPIF system was unavailable for uploads on 
Friday, July 3, 2026, and, as a result, the station was delayed in 
completing such uploads due to technical difficulties with the OPIF. See 
47 C.F.R. § 73.1943(d)  
The station promptly uploaded the materials once the 
OPIF was back online and in service.
